title: Why Your Zoom Lens Loses Focus When You Zoom
excerpt: A bench test of ten copies of the same 70-200mm found focus drifting an average of 0.374mm across the zoom range. Autofocus hides it. Manual focus, video, and astro work do not.

title: Lumix Has the Video Chops to Beat Sony. So Why Won't It Try?
excerpt: Panasonic's cameras out-shoot Sony on stabilization and record modes, yet the FX3 owns the set. The gap is not the sensor. It is the shape of the camera, and what producers recognize when they see it.

title: The Strongest Photos Leave Something Out
excerpt: Photographer Max Kent argues that curiosity is what separates an ordinary photograph from one that stays with a viewer. Show less, and the viewer does the work, and remembers the picture.
